delivered_successor_repairs.environment_and_failure_custody: durable environment, write-once first-failure, and EXIT receipts with shell fallbacks
delivered_successor_repairs.global_nonduplication: flock-guarded shared registry with all three historical keys prebound and checkout-local authority removed
delivered_successor_repairs.integer_timing: generation timing is emitted only as canonical integer milliseconds
delivered_successor_repairs.phase1_checkpoint: every phase-1 file is copied, hashed, verified, and atomically published before structural execution
delivered_successor_repairs.positive_witness_gate: standard-library-only independent re-summation of every SAT witness
delivered_successor_repairs.unsat_gate: every UNSAT certificate remains subject to the pinned external drat-trim batch gate

required_before_submission: freeze the exact reviewed successor commit
place a writable shared global registry root outside the checkout
choose a fresh durable job root outside the checkout
obtain a new operator-supplied one-shot execution request binding the exact successor commit, SOURCE_MANIFEST digest, new key, durable root, and registry root
run only slurm/submit_orion04_crb_full_replay.sh; never reuse a historical key
